description: A bicycle bill of materials four levels deep in the Svelte 5 data grid. The finished product breaks into assemblies, sub-assemblies and parts; every non-leaf row's quantity is one per parent and its unit cost and subtotal are roll-ups summed from its children, while leaf parts carry an explicit quantity and unit cost. Double-click a leaf's quantity or cost and the whole ancestor chain up to the grand total recomputes.

faq.question: How are the subtotals computed?
faq.answer: Bottom-up. A leaf's subtotal is quantity times unit cost; each assembly's subtotal is the sum of its children's subtotals, computed in a $derived over the flat part list whenever a leaf is edited.

faq.question: Which rows are editable?
faq.answer: Only leaf parts. The editable function on the quantity and unit cost columns checks whether the row has children, so assemblies show computed values that cannot be typed over.

faq.question: How is the tree drawn?
faq.answer: The first column uses a cell snippet with indent and a chevron based on the row's depth, and a visible-rows $derived hides collapsed subtrees, the same pattern as the org chart demo.
